listing.name: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a King (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Play My Life as a King with darkuni's Windows recompilation and your own WiiWare WAD.
listing.original_game_title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a King

steps.title: Prepare the WiiWare originals
steps.instruction: Copy your own NTSC-U My Life as a King base WAD (WFCE) beside mylifeking.exe, plus the matching optional add-on content WAD if you have it, and keep your originals separately. On first start the game builds its game folder from them in a few seconds; after that the copied WADs are no longer needed.

steps.title: Let the game import the WADs
steps.instruction: Run mylifeking.exe. The first start populates game and, with the add-on WAD, game/dlc. To add the add-on content later, delete the game folder and start again with both WADs in place; saves in nand stay. If the first start failed or used the wrong WAD, delete the game folder and start again with the right WAD in place.

steps.title: Keep saves and settings
steps.instruction: Keep nand, mylifeking.ini and the generated game folder with the program.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code and bundled fonts that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.

presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, copy your own NTSC-U My Life as a King base WAD (WFCE), and the matching add-on content WAD if you have it, into the managed folder beside mylifeking.exe, and keep your originals separately. On first Play the game builds its game folder from them; without a base WAD it shows Game files not found and closes. Once the game has started, delete the copied WADs so they are not kept in backups. To add the add-on content later, delete the game folder and start again with both WADs in place; saves in nand stay. If the first start failed or used the wrong WAD, delete the game folder and start again with the right WAD in place. The download is the recompiled program with SDL2 and contains no game data; the project license does not cover the recompiled game code, and its system font replacements are Apache-licensed Droid Sans with a DejaVu Sans Mono bitmap. Portcove preserves game, nand (saves) and mylifeking.ini across updates and backups. The log beside the program is a diagnostic; record-audio.bat starts the game outside Portcove and records mlk_audio.wav beside the program for sound bug reports; delete that file when you no longer need it. The game needs a GPU with OpenGL 3.3. Portcove replaces the program; upstream owns WAD import and save formats.
